title: crypto2dev_akcipher.c: register RSA sign/verify/encrypt/decrypt
description: Register RSA as a kernel akcipher algorithm. Implement: .set_pub_key (DER-encoded, call wc_RsaPublicKeyDecode), .set_priv_key (DER-encoded, call wc_RsaPrivateKeyDecode), .encrypt (wc_RsaPublicEncrypt), .decrypt (wc_RsaPrivateDecrypt), .sign (wc_RsaSSL_Sign), .verify (wc_RsaSSL_Verify), .max_size (return key size in bytes). Context struct holds wolfCrypt RsaKey and WC_RNG. RsaKey must be initialized with wc_InitRsaKey before use and freed with wc_FreeRsaKey on exit (memzero_explicit the context).
design: RSA operations require a WC_RNG for blinding — initialize once in .init, free in .exit. FIPS minimum key size is 2048 bits — return -EINVAL for smaller keys and document this in a comment. DER key format: the kernel akcipher API passes raw DER bytes. Output buffer for .max_size must be the modulus length in bytes. See DESIGN.md §akcipher.
acceptance_criteria: RSA-2048 sign/verify roundtrip with PKCS#1 v1.5 passes. Tampered signature returns error. .max_size returns 256 for RSA-2048. Module compiles with zero warnings.
close_reason: Stale: from abandoned kernel-crypto-API-registration design. crypto2dev does not register into kernel crypto API (wolfcrypt.ko does that). Current implementation uses chardev+provider model instead.
